::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
Deep RL learns control policies from reward rather than labels: **DQN** (2013,
Q-learning + deep nets on Atari) → **AlphaGo/AlphaZero** (search + self-play) →
**policy-gradient / PPO** (Schulman 2017) — the optimizer underneath RLHF.
:::

**Depends on:** [Optimization — GD, SGD, Momentum](../00_foundations/06_optimization.qmd)
